clue.text: Special skill required with board game — it's very close

parts.note: a deft touch is a special skill, as in a pianist's touch
and can stand for with, both meaning together alongside
GO is the oriental board game of black and white stones

explanation.surface: A tense board game demands real expertise and ends in a nail-biting finish.
explanation.definitionFit: Something touch and go is precarious, with the outcome uncertain until the last moment.

clue.text: Get opening pieces in Othello right, sage — or else!

indicators.note: the first part of the following word is taken

parts.note: a sage is wise; sage as adjective means wise

explanation.surface: A threat to a sage to get the opening moves of Othello right.
explanation.definitionFit: It is an adverb meaning if not, failing that.

clue.text: Lots of players making throws

definitions.meaning: groups of actors in plays, several companies of performers
flings or hurls, as in angling

explanation.surface: Many performers are making throws.
explanation.definitionFit: Groups of actors are troupes, and to hurl or fling is the verb sense.

clue.text: Bishop captured by powerful man on board — end of game's wonderful

indicators.note: says one piece is held inside another

parts.note: an admiral commands on board a ship
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

indicators.note: takes only the last letter of the word game

explanation.surface: A bishop is taken by a strong piece on the chessboard, ending the game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on board' suggests a chessboard, but it means aboard ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Something marvellous deserves to be admired.

clue.text: Energetically moving piece up in draughts, you invite counter, initially

indicators.note: one group of letters goes inside the other
the first letters of the following words are taken
in a down entry this reads upwards, so the word is turned around

parts.note: a man is a piece in draughts or chess

explanation.surface: A draughts player moves a piece forward to invite a counter-attack.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface has a draughts player inviting a counter-attack, but 'counter' is just a word to take the first letter of, and 'piece' is the draughts man.
explanation.definitionFit: Dynamic means vigorous, full of active motion.

clue.text: Love to struggle with one traditional game

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, a round O
a war is a struggle
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A love of struggle with a traditional game.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a mancala board game of West Africa, played by sowing seeds in pits.

clue.text: Partner's decisive win

definitions.meaning: a partner or companion, as in a pal or spouse
the checkmate that ends a chess game outright

explanation.surface: A partner's victory settles the game.
explanation.definitionFit: A pal is a companion, and in chess the final winning blow is the checkmate.

clue.text: Dealer giving one a king or queen?

definitions.text: Dealer giving one a king or queen?

parts.words: Dealer giving one a king or queen?
parts.note: a broker trades between parties, and on the chessboard the king and queen stand at the centre of the back row

explanation.surface: A card dealer hands someone a court card.
explanation.walkthrough: The card-dealing picture misleads: the king and queen are the central pieces of a chess rank.
explanation.definitionFit: A dealer or broker stands between buyer and seller.

clue.text: After shuffling a lot, new cards not dealt

indicators.note: mixing cards up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: After a big shuffle, new cards left undealt.
explanation.definitionFit: In card games the stock left over after the deal is so called.

clue.text: The most powerful one in the game is female, however

definitions.text: The most powerful one in the game is female, however

parts.words: The most powerful one in the game is female, however
parts.note: the queen is the strongest piece in chess, yet the general word for any piece names it as a man despite her being a woman

explanation.surface: A remark that the strongest figure in the contest is a woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Any piece used in chess, the queen included, is called by this word ending in man.

clue.text: Half a dozen discards from hand allowed as well

indicators.note: six letters are let go from within the words, so the inner run of that length is kept from the phrase that follows

explanation.surface: Throwing away six cards from your hand is also permitted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Half a dozen discards from' tells you to take six letters hidden in 'hand allowed', dropping the H and the OWED.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a tag meaning also, besides, in addition.

clue.text: East the person bidding higher, we hear, in rubber

parts.note: E is the compass abbreviation for East, also a bridge seat

indicators.note: says that the words before are to be taken as they sound when spoken

parts.note: someone who raises the bid at bridge is a raiser

explanation.surface: In a rubber of bridge, East is heard to be the player outbidding everyone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rubber' looks like the bridge term from the surface but is the definition, the thing that rubs out pencil marks.
explanation.definitionFit: A rubber is the British word for a pencil-mark remover.

clue.text: How a chess game is likely to continue, many coaches' take it

definitions.text: How a chess game is likely to continue
definitions.meaning: the standard, most-played sequence of opening moves in chess theory
a principal railway route, travelled by many railway carriages

explanation.surface: Many chess coaches have a view on how a game ought to unfold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coaches' suggests chess trainers, but here they are railway carriages.
explanation.definitionFit: In chess theory the principal variation is called this, and on the railways it names a trunk route.

clue.text: Attempts to get card game under way

definitions.meaning: at bridge play begins with the auction, each player making calls

explanation.surface: Efforts to start a game of cards.
explanation.definitionFit: Tries are attempts, and at bridge the auction of calls opens the deal.

clue.text: Piece of furniture not the central place for games?

parts.note: at the side rather than in the middle
chess and draughts are played on a board

explanation.surface: Asks whether the chief games area is not a furniture item.
explanation.definitionFit: A dining-room cupboard for crockery is a buffet.

clue.text: Champion gets something to eat after game

parts.note: to champion a cause is to back it
gammon is cured ham, a cut of meat to eat

explanation.surface: A champion has a meal after the match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Champion' reads as a noun, the winner, but is the verb meaning support.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a board game for two played with dice and counters.

clue.text: Run around to get number of bridge players needed in game

indicators.note: one piece is put inside the other

parts.note: game as an adjective means plucky, brave
bridge has four players, IV in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Rushing around to find four players for bridge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'game' looks like a noun but is the adjective meaning brave.
explanation.definitionFit: To roam around in search of fun is to gad about.

clue.text: Like Black and White, work both ways with positions

parts.note: op is the abbreviation for opus, a work

indicators.note: written forwards and then backwards

parts.note: op is the abbreviation for opus, a work
sites are positions or locations

explanation.surface: Black and White in chess work in different positions.
explanation.definitionFit: Black and White are contraries, each the reverse of the other.

clue.text: Draw with this line placed strategically

indicators.note: arranged by strategy, so the letters of the words before are rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A chess game ends in a draw, a line of play carefully placed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Draw' suggests a drawn game of chess; here it means to sketch.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the common writing and sketching tool with a graphite core.

clue.text: With openings in chess, dared to go wrong? Hard cheese!

indicators.note: takes the start of the word chess
the letters err from their order, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone dared a chess opening that went wrong, and is told: too bad!
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hard cheese!' sounds like the British exclamation of mock sympathy, but here it is literal.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a firm English cheese from Somerset.

clue.text: Card-players' calls made in bridge, going towards West

indicators.note: in an across entry, travelling west means reading from right to left, so the word is turned around

parts.note: a span is a bridge or the arch of one

explanation.surface: Bids made at the bridge table moving round towards the West seat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bridge' is the card game in the surface but in the wordplay a structure over a river.
explanation.definitionFit: In the card game nap, a player's bid is a nap, so the calls are these.

clue.text: Cheat to secure a point in this game

parts.note: to crib is to copy dishonestly, to cheat
to bag something is to secure or obtain it
E, East, is one of the points of the compass

explanation.surface: A cheat tries to snatch a point in this card game.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a card game scored by pegging holes on a board.

clue.text: More than one man in game cheats

definitions.text: More than one man in game
definitions.meaning: chess castles, the pieces at the corners

explanation.surface: Several chessmen are cheating.
explanation.definitionFit: Castles in chess bear this name, and swindling someone is rooking them.

clue.text: Poker bets made by opponents, say

indicators.note: indicates the word before is spoken aloud

parts.note: antis are people opposed to something

explanation.surface: Stakes at poker put up by opponents.
explanation.definitionFit: Stakes put in before the deal at poker are called this.

clue.text: Deepest move initially is not worked out

indicators.note: puzzled out or solved, so the letters are rearranged
takes only the first letter of the word move

explanation.surface: The deepest strategy was not yet solved by the first move.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' gives M from 'move'; 'worked out' rearranges M with ISNOT.
explanation.definitionFit: Innermost thoughts are the deepest, furthest within.

clue.text: Giant first in Mastermind, extremely eager

indicators.note: takes the first letter of Mastermind

parts.note: agog means very eager, excited

explanation.surface: A giant leads in the quiz show Mastermind, very eager.
explanation.walkthrough: Mastermind is a British TV quiz.
explanation.definitionFit: Gog and the other named figure are legendary giants of London's Guildhall.

clue.text: Small vehicle king used in game with skill

parts.note: GO is the oriental board game
K is the chess abbreviation for king
art is skill or craft

explanation.surface: A small piece, the king, is used with skill in a game.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a small low racing car, a kart, driven on circuits.

clue.text: Lots of drawing in this game

definitions.meaning: drinks, swallows or currents of air, many acts of drawing in
the board game called checkers in America

explanation.surface: This game involves plenty of draws.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drawing' suggests drawn games, but it means drawing in air or liquid.
explanation.definitionFit: Gulps of liquid and currents of air are both so called, and it is the British name for checkers.

clue.text: Exploited ruse Diplomacy requires

indicators.note: the words that follow need these letters, which sit inside them

explanation.surface: A trick was exploited, as the board game Diplomacy demands.
explanation.walkthrough: Diplomacy is a board game of negotiation and betrayal.
explanation.definitionFit: To have exploited something is to have taken advantage of it, made use of it.

clue.text: Player looking ahead gets start I bungled

indicators.note: botched or messed up, so the letters are put in a muddled order

explanation.surface: A player thinking ahead makes a poor start, says he.
explanation.definitionFit: A planner who plans moves in advance is a tactician of this kind.
